meta.title: Implement intelligent test selection for github actions
meta.body_summary: Implements an intelligent test selection system that reduces CI runtime from 5+ minutes to targeted windows (1-5 minutes) based on the scope of changes in a pull request.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot CI test scheduler with narrative time savings; multiple rounds of test-failure fixes and design review, approved but closed without merge as potentially superseded by alternate approach (AlexEMG’s branch).

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3716 changed lines, this is a large change by absolute volume, reflecting addition of a new test selection system, workflow modifications, and a merge from main. As a CI optimization PR, it was closed without merge after approval, possibly due to strategic rework rather than code quality.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer MMathisLab reported that tests were still failing and requested verbose debugging; also workflow duplication where python-package.yml still triggered on push alongside intelligent-testing.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce CI runtime from 5+ minutes to 1-5 minutes based on change scope, with 60-80% time savings for documentation-only changes.
review_details.rejection_signals: Despite final approval, PR was not merged and later closed, likely because of parallel work on 'ReworkCICD' branch (AlexEMG comment).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: CI/workflow generator tool requiring robust handling of YAML syntax, multi-workflow interactions, and test compatibility; agent succeeded in fixing issues but final merge was superseded by an alternative approach.

detection_detail.code_reading: MMathisLab reviewed workflow duplication and test failures; deruyter92 suggested changes to test selection rules.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI logs showed syntax errors and test failures.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes estimated time savings table, but no measurement in CI; maintainer focused on test correctness, not benchmark.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Multiple commits addressed syntax errors, missing dependencies, and test failures; PR approved but closed later.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced intelligent test selection system with tools/test_selector.py, tools/parse_test_selection.py, tools/execute_test_commands.py, added .github/workflows/intelligent-testing.yml, modified python-package.yml, and added docs and validate scripts.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Major merge commit added many main branch files (gui, modelzoo, etc.) unrelated to test selection.
change_trajectory: Initial implementation with test_selector, docs, and intelligent-testing.yml.
Fix test failures and add robustness.

Maintainer approvals after fixes; PR later closed without merge likely due to alternative approach.
